conviction_note: This is the full-year print, so what matters is the first FY27 forecast. Last October the first guide was conservative (FY26 OP 1,900m against a year that ran to 5,274m by Q3) and the stock fell 6.9%, then another 6.0% the next day. The only consensus is one IFIS analyst at roughly +50% FY27 ordinary profit, and margin longs keep building at 58x. Against that, FY26 net profit is already above plan, the dividend tracks a ~20% payout, and there was a buyback in January. So I set p_up=42 on abs_move 7.0, giving -1.12. impact_sum is -1.4. The two numbers agree in sign and size.

findings.finding: This is a full-year print, so the first FY27 forecast is the main item. This company's first guides are conservative: FY26 opened at OP 1,900m / net 730m / div 15 against FY25 actual OP 1,453m, and was raised twice to 5,500m. Its last two full-year prints with a new guide fell (2025-10-14 -6.92% then -5.97% on 10-15; 2024-10-15 -26.49%). The only consensus (IFIS, 1 analyst) has FY27 ordinary profit at +50.2% (~8.2bn), and the company's own language stresses 'マーケット環境が不安定' and continued investment.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: First-guide prints: 2025-10-10 release -> 10-14 -6.92%, 10-15 -5.97%; 2024-10-11 release -> 10-15 -26.49%. In-year upward revisions went limit-up: 2026-01-13 +22.92%, 2026-04-13 +23.9% (stop-high). Q3 2026-07-13, no revision: +1.1%. Daily bars from https://query1.finance.yahoo.com/v8/finance/chart/9270.T?range=2y&interval=1d
findings.why_not_priced: The stock trades at 8.1x the company's FY26 EPS and below the one analyst's 2,900 target, so the market is not paying for +50% growth. What is not priced is a low first guide. The stock fell 8.5% over 20 days, yet margin longs rose every week (the run-up is not retail selling), and the only published forward number is the bullish analyst's. If the market had priced a conservative FY27 guide, margin longs would be coming down into the print rather than rising to 58x.
findings.independence: Q3 tanshin (https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260710/140120260709590614.pdf) kept the plan despite 97.5% progress, citing Q4 '来期以降の成長に向けた戦略的な投資'. The April revision notice (https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260410/140120260407599609.pdf) cited 'マーケット環境が不安定な状況'. The IFIS consensus is a separate source: https://kabuyoho.jp/reportAnalyst?bcode=9270. The reaction history is my own read of Yahoo bars.

findings.finding: FY26 will clear the company plan, mostly on visible numbers. Q1-Q3 net profit is 3,314m against a full-year plan of 3,000m, so the plan implies a Q4 net loss of 314m; Q4 implied OP is 226m. Peers' June-August monthly figures show volume still strong: Komehyo brand sales +30.5%/+25.4%/+32.6% and personal buying +29.7%/+47.0%/+38.2%; BuySell August store buying +40%. Against that, Komehyo reports B2B (法人販売) profit slightly below plan in July and August, auction prices for jewellery and watches soft in July, and high-end watches soft in August, after gold fell about 12% in June. Net: a modest beat against the plan, roughly in line with IFIS 5,669m.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q3 FY26 (2026-07-10): OP 4.1x YoY, plan held, next session +1.1% close. Q3 FY25 (2025-07-11): +0.22%. Quarter-only prints without a revision have moved about 1%.
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced. The 進捗率 (97.5% of ordinary, 110% of net) is public on kabuyoho, and the peers' monthlies are TDnet filings. The only unpriced part is how much of the Q4 investment and the logistics consolidation (TRC into Tokyo SRC) actually landed, and that cuts both ways. So it is sized near zero.
findings.independence: Q3 tanshin and Q3 deck (https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260710/140120260709590621.pdf) for Valuence's own run-rate, a different source from the peer monthlies. Gold monthly closes from https://query1.finance.yahoo.com/v8/finance/chart/GC%3DF?range=1y&interval=1mo (May 4,593 -> June 4,038.5).

findings.finding: Margin longs have been building into the print: 375,300 shares on 09-04 rising to 423,800 on 10-02, up every week. Margin shorts fell from 12,800 to 7,300, taking 信用倍率 from 33.8 to 58.05, and nothing is disclosed on the short register. That is about 9 sessions of volume held long on leverage, and much of it is under water after the April limit-up at 2,600-2,700 and the July high at 2,200.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: 2025-10-14 (-6.92%) was followed by another -5.97% on 10-15, which fits leveraged holders exiting after a disappointing guide; the margin balance at that date was not checked.
findings.why_not_priced: The level (58.05x) is in the baseline lean as margin_overhang -0.88, so only the trend is new: the balance is still rising five weeks into a falling tape. This finding is asymmetric. It adds sellers only if the guide disappoints, and there is no short base to squeeze on good news, so it is kept small.
findings.independence: Same fact as the baseline's margin_ratio; the weekly series is the same Yahoo page. Merged nothing; no other source.

findings.finding: Shareholder returns are rising with profit. The dividend went 10 (FY25) -> 15 (initial FY26) -> 30 (Jan) -> 45 (Apr), held at a ~20% payout (FY26 plan 19.8%), and the company bought ¥275m of its own shares in January 2026. With FY26 net already 3,314m against the 3,000m plan, a year-end top-up or a higher FY27 dividend guide is mechanically likely if the payout is held.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Both dividend raises came with upward profit revisions that went limit-up (2026-01-13, 2026-04-13), so the dividend's own effect cannot be separated.
findings.source_date: 2026-04-10 (Q2 deck, 配当方針 page with payout history); buyback in Q3 tanshin https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260710/140120260709590614.pdf ('2026年１月に自己株式を275百万円取得')
findings.why_not_priced: At 1,842 the 45-yen plan is a 2.4% yield. A top-up to about 50 yen on the actual EPS, or a FY27 dividend near 55-60 yen on a ~20% payout, has not been announced, and no source carries a forecast for it. The cash pull from inventory (10.4bn -> 15.8bn, negative FCF) argues against a large buyback, so this is sized small.
findings.independence: Payout history in the Q2 deck; the buyback amount in the Q3 tanshin. Both are company documents but different filings.

bar_hierarchy: Forecast revision: none filed. FY26 is fully elapsed; the actual will clear the plan on net (Q1-Q3 net 3,314m vs plan 3,000m) and land near IFIS on OP. Returns: dividend top-up above 45 yen and a higher FY27 dividend are likely on a ~20% payout; a buyback is possible (January precedent) but inventory build argues against it. New-year guide: THE item. The company habitually opens low, and last October's opening guide fell 6.9% plus 6.0%; the only bar is one IFIS analyst at +50% ordinary. Quarter vs own 進捗率: Q3 cumulative ordinary 97.5% vs 106.4% at the same point of FY25 and 93.1% for FY24 OP; the plan was held conservatively, so Q4 is not the story.

baseline_tension: This agrees with the baseline lean (-0.457, from margin overhang) and the -8.5% 20-day run-in, and leans further the same way through the guidance habit. The strongest positive the release could carry: a FY27 guide near the analyst's +50%, a dividend top-up plus a higher FY27 dividend, or a buyback (January precedent). I looked for all of these: nothing has been pre-announced, and dividends are filed as F4 (+0.7). The 8x P/E also limits how far a modest guide can be punished.
